text:
# SEO and GEO audit: Quay (SvelteKit)

The repo is small: three routes, a layout, `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml`. I found 9 problems. The first two block indexing, so fix those first.

## Critical

1. **`static/robots.txt:4-5`: Googlebot is blocked from the whole site.**
   - `User-agent: Googlebot` / `Disallow: /` overrides the `*` group for Google, so nothing gets crawled.
   - Fix: delete lines 4-5. If you want to block only certain paths, list those specific paths instead.

2. **`src/routes/+layout.ts:1`: `export const ssr = false` makes the whole site client-rendered.**
   - The server sends an empty shell. Titles, meta tags, canonicals, JSON-LD and body content only appear after JavaScript runs.
   - Googlebot renders JS, but with a delay. Most AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others) don't run JS, so they see no content at all.
   - Fix: remove the line, or set `ssr = true`. Use `export const prerender = true` for static pages like these.

## High

3. **`src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3`: the meta description is empty (`content=""`).**
   - Google will make up its own snippet.
   - Fix: write a real description, for example "Bilge pumps, cleats and rope for boats. Next-day delivery."

4. **`src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`: the Product JSON-LD is invalid and thin.**
   - A `Product` needs `offers` (price, currency, availability) or a review or rating to be eligible for rich results. This one only has `name`.
   - `/shop` is a listing page of many parts, not a single Bilge pump. Use `ItemList` with per-product `Product` entries, or put the `Product` markup on individual product pages.
   - `{@html}` in `<svelte:head>` works but is fragile. Build the JSON string with `JSON.stringify` and escape `<` as `\u003c`.

5. **`src/app.html:2`: `<html>` has no `lang` attribute.**
   - Fix: `<html lang="en-GB">`. The `£` on line 7 of the layout suggests a UK audience.

6. **`src/app.html:4-5`: there is no `<meta name="viewport">`.**
   - Without it, mobile rendering and mobile-first indexing suffer.
   - Fix: add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />`.

## Medium

7. **`static/sitemap.xml:3-4`: the sitemap has no `<lastmod>`, and the domain is `quay.example`.**
   - `quay.example` is a placeholder, and it also appears in `robots.txt:7` and the canonicals. Replace all of them with the production domain, ideally from one config value.
   - Add `<lastmod>`. Keep `/search` out of the sitemap, which it currently is.

8. **`src/routes/+layout.svelte:7`: `data-nosnippet` hides the free-delivery line from search snippets and AI answers.**
   - If you want "Free delivery over £50" to appear in results, remove the attribute. Keep it only if that's deliberate.
   - The line also sits outside any `<footer>`, `<main>` or landmark element. The `<nav>` on line 5 has no `aria-label`.

9. **Thin content and weak titles/metadata across pages.**
   - `src/routes/+page.svelte:2`: the title "Quay: boat parts" is acceptable. Better: "Quay | Marine boat parts, shipped next day".
   - `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:2`: "Shop all parts" has no brand and no keywords. Try "Boat parts: bilge pumps, cleats & rope | Quay".
   - `src/routes/+page.svelte:7` and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:8-9` hold almost no text and no links to products or categories.
   - No page has Open Graph or Twitter tags (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `og:url`), which affects link previews and some AI citations.
   - Nothing links to the search page, and the home page has no internal links beyond the nav.

## GEO-specific gaps

- **No Organization or WebSite JSON-LD.** Add it to the layout with name, URL, logo and `sameAs` links, so AI systems can identify the brand.
- **No `llms.txt`.** It's optional, but cheap: add `static/llms.txt` with a short site summary and key URLs.
- **No explicit AI-crawler rules.** The `*` group allows everything, which is fine once the Googlebot block is gone. If you want to restrict particular bots, add separate groups for them.
- **No factual content for AI to quote.** Add specs, delivery terms, a returns policy, an FAQ (with `FAQPage` markup if it's genuine) and product descriptions.

## Suggested fix order

1. Remove the Googlebot block (`robots.txt:4-5`).
2. Turn SSR on or prerender (`+layout.ts:1`).
3. Fix `lang` and `viewport` in `app.html`.
4. Fill in the shop description and fix the JSON-LD.
5. Replace the placeholder domain, add `lastmod`, add OG tags and Organization schema.

I haven't changed any files. I can apply these fixes if you want.
